answer: Identity ageing with graded probation stops Sybils by making a new identity earn its voice slowly, not buy it instantly. A newcomer starts with no earning or voting power and must complete peer-graded tasks across several epochs; only non-duplicate work unlocks full standing. An honest agent pays this once, while an attacker must maintain thousands of fakes through the same long probation, writing work for each, or they never mature. Shortcuts show: a violet flag marks rushed accounts, a ridge of identical submissions links a farm, and copied pigment exposes clusters early.
